data.title: Getafe vs Rayo Vallecano Lineups, Prediction, Betting Picks & Odds
data.content:
### Getafe

Juanmi is still out with a knee injury and isn't expected back until November, while Christantus Uche is sidelined until May 2027 with cruciate ligament and meniscus damage. Enes Ünal and Orel Mangala are doubts with muscular problems, Ivan Azon is also a doubt and Zaid Romero is nursing a quad issue. The good news is Abdel Abqar, who is back in contention and expected to start in the back three.

### Rayo Vallecano [...] Getafe: Juanmi (Injured/out), Christantus Uche (Injured/out), Enes Ünal (Injured/doubtful), Orel Mangala (Injured/doubtful), Ivan Azon (Injured/doubtful), Zaid Romero (Injured/doubtful)

Rayo Vallecano: Augusto Batalla (Injured/out), Andrei Ratiu (Injured/doubtful)

### Getafe [...] ### Rayo Vallecano

Goalkeeper Augusto Batalla remains out with a fractured tibia and isn't expected back until January. Andrei Ratiu is a doubt with an undisclosed problem. On the plus side, Ivan Balliu returns to the squad and Luiz Felipe is available again.
